reason: This plugin is mainly a DSH web UI branding/appearance plugin: it replaces the fixed top-left wordmark with user-configured image or text, adds an inline on-logo settings handle and panel, and persists preferences locally in the browser; it does not present external integrations or workflow automation beyond in-interface customization.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面左上角，该插件可将默认品牌标志替换为自定义图片或文字，并提供内联设置入口快速打开配置。
summaries.en: In the DSH web UI, this plugin lets you replace the default top-left logo with your own image or text and open a settings UI from an inline control on the wordmark.

reasons.code: README states the plugin appends elements to the DSH `button.brand` wordmark and hides the original SVG via a sibling selector to replace the top-left logo/wordmark.
README documents persistence of runtime choice in `window.localStorage` under `dsh.custom-logo.v1` with fields for mode, text, color, alignment, and font size.
README notes image mode accepts PNG/SVG/JPG uploads with a 256 KB limit and uses browser-side processing (`FileReader` data URL).
